New notice FFSB-SN-2026-737 - 'Encryption of customer data at rest' - has been issued by Fictional Financial Standards Board (FFSB).

Please identify which of our systems are affected and confirm whether encryption at rest is in plaace for each of them.
signature:
Quentin Quayle
Manager, Compliance
Harbourline Mutual Finance Ltd
subject: Notice FFSB-SN-2026-737 - please assess
